name: @klangk/klangk-jwt
description: Retrieve the browser's klangk session JWT via the bridge, consent-gated

KLANGKWS_FEATURE_KLANGK_JWT_REQUIRE_CONS.description: When true (the default), the browser tab asks the user to confirm each retrieval of the session token by the klangk-jwt feature; set false to return the token to any bridge-authenticated caller in the workspace without a prompt
